reading_route.title: A useful booking story with independent permissions

section.claim_ref: The synthetic football reference produced a three-slot mock booking and reusable history.
D1 acceptance used an explicit fourth-correction amendment; the original G54D remains INCOMPLETE.
The original request has three 90-minute sessions and a 7,000-minor-EUR budget.
The natural-grass field has an 8 January 11:00–11:30 occupancy conflict; the cheaper artificial field is ineligible.
Selection checks half-open overlap, 90-minute duration, field requirements and budget.
The real EXACT response proposed FIND_OFFER, revision 1 and allowances [0,0,0].
Both live roles consumed EXACT; one pure Work per side yielded NO_COMPLETE_OFFER without an effect.
SHIFT changed only the 8 January allowance to 30 minutes, preserving original times and budget.
The selected sessions total 6,300 minor EUR; only 8 January moves, to 11:30–13:00.
The live SHIFT proposal reached both roles and produced OFFER_READY without booking.
Main SHIFT contains distinct native producer and consumer Work owned by VenueRoot and ActivePlanetRoot.
The evidence contract relates E, B and C through B.offer=E and C.body=B, with later status checks in C.
BOOK is a separate controlled owner input bound by local policy.
Main BOOK records one dispatch/executor/effect and creates three registry records plus one idempotency entry.
The native receipt is evidence-only and is checked against registry and independent readback.
Main REPEAT and VERIFY preserve the receipt and registry, with zero new Work or mock effect.
The real VERIFY_EXISTING proposal was consumed later; the provider had not seen the later native receipt.
The live series has three gemini-2.5-flash requests, three wire sends and no extra retry attempts in the retained ledger.
EXACT, SHIFT and VERIFY hashes match actual intake at both roles and are joined to native outcomes.
The model interface receives an explicit system prompt, schema and, for later proposals, the preceding normalized request.
The final native matrix has 16 PASS cases, 56 events and 7 isolated mock executor starts.
The final variation is a preserved G54D challenge reused after the amendment, not a fresh unseen benchmark.
D1 revoked_source contains actual local BLOCKED_FAIL_CLOSED decisions bound to authenticated terminal status and original requests.
The revoked case has two events and no dispatch/executor start; G54D remains historically INCOMPLETE.
Permuted, changed-data, second-team and continuation cases use the same final candidate.
The final reserved variation totals 6,798 minor EUR; second-team and continuation totals are 6,414.
Nine altered-evidence controls are a separate pure group, not native attacks.
D1 native and live are distinct groups: 16/56/7 and 3 provider calls/5 events/1 mock effect respectively.
D1 supplied one and two are identical 32,702-byte pure verification results with the stated SHA-256.
The installed verifier rechecks saved evidence without new candidate/provider/native authority or effects.
The independent D1 review checked362 Ed25519 native messages,25 completed FIND E/B/C joins and7 confirmation consumptions.
The owner reports a real sports-camp planning motivation; executed venue data and prices are synthetic.
Three genuine provider responses supplied fields that the subsequent program consumed.
Only the January 8 shift allowance changed to 30 minutes.
Actual producer and consumer Work operate under independent local Roots.
Booking requires separate controlled owner consent.
One main mock effect creates three reservations, a receipt and independently read state.
Repeated confirmation and verification preserve the receipt without another effect.
Sixteen native cases and the distinct live series have separate event and effect counts.

reading_route.orientation: EXACT preserves all requested times and yields NO_COMPLETE_OFFER. SHIFT changes only January 8 allowance to 30 minutes; 3 × 2100 = 6300 minor EUR within 7000.
CONFIRM is a controlled owner input. One native mock execution creates three reservations and one idempotency entry. REPEAT and VERIFY do not repeat that effect.
The runtime semantic provider is gemini-2.5-flash. Three actual proposals were collected before the native live run. The VERIFY model did not see the later receipt.
D1 native means 16 cases, 56 events and 7 isolated mock executions. Its separate live series means 3 provider calls, 5 events and 1 additional mock execution.
Synthetic venue/inventory/prices; real framework activity and registry mutation in the declared reviewed-reference test. No real stadium contract or payment.
